'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Blake Huffman LS Let The Wookiee Win (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let The Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)|VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif|label=Let The Wookiee Win (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' LTWW TRM
* '''Username:''' Anodos
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
